notes: The in-app updater is back. Directly installed builds can check for a new version and install it from Settings again, instead of only being replaceable by hand. If Android has not yet been told Corlang may install an app, the card now says so and takes you to the one setting that allows it, rather than failing silently. The release notes for the waiting version are shown before you install it. The Google Play build is unaffected and still updates through the store. The privacy policy link in Settings now opens corlang.app/privacy instead of a raw file on GitHub.
